integrity: All universal statements follow from a symbolic two-dimensional matrix identity or exhaustive rational evaluation of a three-dimensional finite sample space. Computational checks reproduce but do not replace those certificates.
scientific_limitations: Exact-coordinate, full-rank symmetric positive-definite quadratic objectives; fixed deterministic initial error; one epoch only; uniform permutations versus independent uniform draws. No implication for all epochs, general nonquadratic objectives, arbitrary sampling, or relative objective risk.
title: A dimension-sharp reshuffling reversal in Euclidean coordinate-descent risk
